meta_hyperglycaemia.name: Hyperglycaemia & Therapeutic Hypothermia Meta-Analysis
meta_hyperglycaemia.inclusion_criteria: ≥35 weeks GA neonates with HIE undergoing active therapeutic hypothermia (0–72h); documented blood glucose; RCT or observational cohort with ≥10 patients per group
meta_hyperglycaemia.exclusion_criteria: Preterm <35 weeks in primary quantitative synthesis; passive cooling; case reports (n<10); missing full-text

pico.population: Neonates with hypoxic-ischaemic encephalopathy (HIE) undergoing therapeutic hypothermia
pico.outcome: Neurodevelopmental outcomes (Bayley scores, mortality, MRI injury)
pico.title: Investigating the effect of hyperglycaemia on neurodevelopmental outcomes in neonates with HIE undergoing therapeutic hypothermia

phase_3.primary_outcome_name: Neurodevelopmental outcomes / Mortality / Brain injury on MRI

neonatal_antibiotics.name: Neonatal Empirical Antibiotic Duration & Safety Meta-Analysis
neonatal_antibiotics.inclusion_criteria: Culture-negative preterm infants (<34-37 weeks, VLBW <1500g) receiving empirical antibiotics in first 72h
neonatal_antibiotics.exclusion_criteria: Culture-positive sepsis within 72h; major congenital anomalies; lack of unexposed/short exposure comparator

pico.population: Culture-negative preterm infants (<34-37 weeks, VLBW <1500g) receiving empirical antibiotics in the first 72 hours of life
pico.intervention_exposure: Prolonged empirical antibiotic exposure (>=4-5 days or high exposure)
pico.comparator: Short empirical antibiotic exposure (<=48-72 hours / stopped upon negative culture) or no exposure
pico.outcome: Necrotizing enterocolitis (Bell stage >=2) and all-cause in-hospital mortality
pico.title: Investigating the effect of prolonged empirical antibiotic exposure on necrotizing enterocolitis and mortality in culture-negative preterm infants: a systematic review and meta-analysis

phase_3.primary_outcome_name: Necrotizing enterocolitis (Bell stage >=2) and all-cause in-hospital mortality

glp1_thermoregulation.name: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists on Thermoregulation & Energy Expenditure Meta-Analysis
glp1_thermoregulation.inclusion_criteria: Adults (>=18y) with overweight or obesity (BMI >=25 kg/m2 or >=30 kg/m2); GLP-1 receptor agonist intervention
glp1_thermoregulation.exclusion_criteria: Pediatric populations; non-incretin weight loss agents without GLP-1 arm; lack of thermoregulatory or energy expenditure outcomes

pico.population: Adults (>=18 years) with overweight or obesity (BMI >=25 kg/m2 or >=30 kg/m2), with or without T2DM
pico.intervention_exposure: GLP-1 receptor agonists and dual incretin mimetics
pico.comparator: Placebo, caloric restriction/lifestyle intervention, active non-incretin comparator, or baseline
pico.outcome: Core/skin temperature, resting energy expenditure, respiratory exchange ratio, fat oxidation, and heat/hydration-related adverse events
pico.title: Investigating the effect of GLP-1 receptor agonists on thermoregulation, energy expenditure, and heat-related adverse events in adults with overweight or obesity: a systematic review and meta-analysis
